pages.text: $(italic)Risen from death's grip, Revenants thrive in shadow. The most punishing race in daylight, the most powerful at night.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Shadow Strike$() — $(item)+20% damage and 30% damage reduction in darkness$() and in The Abyss.$(br2)$(bold)Deathless Eyes$() — $(item)Enhanced night vision$(). See even better in darkness than other dark-sighted races.$(br2)$(bold)Sunlight Sensitivity$() — $(warn)Direct sunlight causes Weakness and Slowness$(). Wear a helmet or stay in shade.$(br2)$(bold)Cursed Flesh$() — $(warn)-20% nourishment from food$(). Your undead body struggles to process sustenance.
